review_candidates.title: Systems Administrator – Hybrid Infrastructure
review_candidates.description: Job Description System Administrator - Hybrid Infrastructure – Job Description Scout Energy is a private energy investment firm that acquires, operates and improves upstream conventional oil and gas and associated midstream properties for institutional investors. Scout’s business is both the management of private energy funds and the operation of the oil and gas assets it owns. Scout is seeking an experienced System Administrator – Hybrid Infrastructure to manage, maintain, and support enterprise infrastructure across on-premises data centers and cloud environments. This position will be responsible for servers, virtualization, networking, Azure, AWS, security, automation, monitoring, and infrastructure deployments. The ideal candidate is a hands-on infrastructure professional with strong systems administration skills, solid networking knowledge, experience with Cisco and Meraki , and the ability to automate administrative and operational tasks using scripting and modern infrastructure tools. The position requires the ability to troubleshoot across multiple technology platforms and support both day-to-day operations and infrastructure projects. This position will report to Scout’s IT Operations Manager as a part of our Information Technology department. Duties & Responsibilities Deploy, configure, and support Azure infrastructure, including virtual machines, virtual networks, subnets, network security groups, storage, monitoring, backup, hybrid connectivity, and other Azure services. Install, configure, maintain, and troubleshoot physical and virtual servers, including Windows and Linux operating systems, virtualization platforms, storage, and associated infrastructure. Deploy and maintain data center infrastructure, including server and network equipment installation, rack and stack activities, cabling, hardware configuration, firmware updates, replacements, and equipment decommissioning Administer Microsoft infrastructure services, including Active Directory, DNS, DHCP, Group Policy, authentication, file services, and hybrid identity integrations. Configure, maintain, and troubleshoot enterprise network infrastructure, including Cisco and Cisco Meraki switches, firewalls, wireless infrastructure, VPNs, VLANs, routing, switching, and network connectivity Develop and maintain automation and scripting solutions using PowerShell, Python, Bash, Azure CLI, AWS CLI, or similar technologies to automate provisioning, administration, monitoring, reporting, maintenance, and repetitive operational tasks. Monitor infrastructure health, performance, availability, capacity, and security, proactively identifying potential issues and implementing corrective actions before they impact business operations Perform system maintenance, patching, upgrades, hardening, and vulnerability remediation across servers, network devices, cloud resources, and other infrastructure components. Troubleshoot and resolve complex infrastructure issues spanning operating systems, servers, networking, virtualization, cloud services, storage, authentication, and connectivity. Implement and support backup, disaster recovery, and business continuity solutions, including recovery testing and participation in infrastructure recovery and disaster recovery exercises. Participate in infrastructure projects and technology initiatives, including cloud migrations, data center migrations, server refreshes, network upgrades, infrastructure modernization, and new system deployments. Collaborate with application, database, security, networking, development, and other IT teams to design, implement, troubleshoot, and maintain infrastructure supporting enterprise applications and services. Maintain accurate infrastructure documentation and operational procedures, including network and infrastructure diagrams, configurations, asset information, standard operating procedures, change documentation, and disaster recovery documentation. Skills & Specifications Experience with VMware, Hyper-V, or other enterprise virtualization technologies Experience with Azure networking, hybrid connectivity, and Azure security services Experience with AWS VPC, EC2, IAM, S3, and CloudWatch. Experience with Infrastructure as Code technologies such as Terraform, Bicep, or ARM templates Experience with Python, Bash, Azure CLI, or AWS CLI Experience with enterprise storage, SAN, RAID, and backup technologies Experience with Microsoft Entra ID and hybrid identity Experience with infrastructure monitoring and logging platforms Relevant Microsoft, Azure, AWS, Cisco, or other industry certifications. Education & Qualifications 5+ years of experience in systems administration, infrastructure administration, or a related IT infrastructure role Strong experience administering Windows Server and Microsoft infrastructure environments Hands-on experience with Active Directory, DNS, DHCP, Group Policy, and virtualization Experience supporting physical servers and data center infrastructure Experience administering or supporting Microsoft Azure environments Strong understanding of networking fundamentals, including TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, VLANs, routing, switching, VPNs, and firewalls Hands-on experience with Cisco and/or Cisco Meraki networking equipment Strong PowerShell scripting and automation experience Ability to troubleshoot complex infrastructure issues across multiple technology platforms Strong understanding of infrastructure security, patching, backup, monitoring, and disaster recovery Strong documentation, communication, analytical, and problem-solving skills.

review_candidates.description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Senior Linux Systems Engineer based in India. This is a hands-on technical leadership opportunity within a Linux Operations environment supporting mission-critical production systems. You will manage, troubleshoot, and optimize Linux infrastructure across hosted, cloud, and remote environments. The role combines advanced incident response, root-cause analysis, automation, infrastructure management, and continuous improvement. You will work across AWS, Azure, and GCP environments while helping maintain secure, highly available, and reliable services. Beyond technical delivery, you will serve as a trusted escalation point and mentor for other engineers. You will collaborate closely with internal teams and external stakeholders, providing clear technical direction during incidents and changes. This role is well suited to an experienced Linux professional who enjoys solving complex infrastructure challenges and driving operational excellence. Accountabilities Take end-to-end ownership of high-priority incidents, major incidents, service requests, and operational tasks, resolving issues with minimal escalation. Lead advanced troubleshooting, root-cause analysis, stabilization, and recovery activities for critical Linux production environments. Implement sustainable fixes and continuous improvements to reduce recurring incidents, improve reliability, and minimize MTTR. Manage and optimize Linux servers across hosted infrastructure, public cloud environments, and remote infrastructure. Develop and maintain Ansible playbooks, Bash scripts, and other automation to eliminate repetitive manual tasks and improve operational efficiency. Support infrastructure-as-code, configuration management, deployment, orchestration, Docker, Kubernetes, and related automation initiatives. Execute infrastructure changes through established ServiceNow and change-management frameworks, including impact analysis, risk assessment, validation, and stakeholder coordination. Create, review, and maintain SOPs, operational runbooks, disaster recovery procedures, and technical documentation. Identify procedural gaps and drive standardization across operational teams while supporting audit and compliance requirements. Monitor system health, configure alerts and dashboards, and use observability data to proactively identify performance and reliability issues. Maintain security, patching, vulnerability remediation, high-availability, and compliance standards across supported infrastructure. Act as a technical escalation point and mentor for junior engineers, providing guidance during complex troubleshooting and knowledge-sharing activities. Communicate clearly with internal teams and external clients regarding incident status, resolution timelines, maintenance activities, and service performance. Requirements 8+ years of hands-on production Linux/Unix administration and support experience in enterprise environments. Advanced troubleshooting capabilities across Linux kernels, networking, storage, system performance, and related infrastructure components. Practical experience with Linux patching, security updates, vulnerability remediation, and system hardening. Strong Bash/shell scripting skills and proven experience developing automation with Ansible. Proficiency with systemd, RPM/APT package management, kernel modules, SSH, sudo, LDAP, and Active Directory authentication. Experience with monitoring and observability platforms such as Datadog, Azure Monitor, Prometheus, or comparable technologies. Ability to work with alerts, dashboards, logs, metrics, traces, and other observability data to diagnose and prevent operational issues. Experience with incident management, change management, risk assessment, service restoration, and continuous improvement. Strong technical documentation skills, including the ability to create clear SOPs, runbooks, and operational procedures. Excellent communication and stakeholder-management skills, with the ability to explain complex technical issues clearly. Strong prioritization and time-management abilities in a multitasking, high-pressure environment. A collaborative and mentoring mindset, with the confidence to guide engineers through complex technical challenges. High attention to detail and a strong commitment to reliability, quality, security, and compliance. Willingness and ability to participate in 24/7 rotational shifts and on-call support when required. Benefits Opportunity to work on mission-critical Linux infrastructure in complex enterprise and cloud environments. Exposure to AWS, Azure, and GCP alongside modern automation, monitoring, and infrastructure technologies. Hands-on experience with automation and operational improvement using tools such as Ansible, Bash, Docker, and Kubernetes. Technical leadership and mentoring opportunities within a collaborative operations environment. Opportunity to work on complex incidents, infrastructure optimization, security, and reliability initiatives. review_candidates.title: System Administrator - Linux / VMware (DoD Systems)
review_candidates.description: Overview Nakupuna Companies is seeking an experienced System Administrator to manage, secure, and optimize our critical Red Hat Enterprise Linux (RHEL) and VMware environments running on Dell enterprise hardware. You will sustain high-availability Department of Defense (DoD) networked servers. You will lead cyber hardening initiatives and leverage Hyper-Converged Infrastructure (HCI) to ensure modernization and strict compliance with federal defense frameworks. Responsibilities The following reflects management’s definition of essential functions for this job but does not restrict the tasks that may be assigned. Management may assign additional duties and responsibilities to this job at any time due to reasonable accommodation or other reasons. Infrastructure Management: Maintain, upgrade, and troubleshoot RHEL 7/8/9 servers and VMware vSphere/vCenter environments. Hardware Administration: Manage Dell PowerEdge enterprise servers, including hardware provisioning, firmware updates, and iDRAC configuration. HCI Architecture: Support and optimize Hyper-Converged Infrastructure solutions to streamline compute, storage, and networking. Cyber Hardening: Apply DISA STIGs (Security Technical Implementation Guides) and SRGs to Linux OS, virtual infrastructure, and Dell hardware. Vulnerability Remediation: Analyze ACAS (Assured Compliance Assessment Solution) / Nessus scans to patch and remediate findings. Network Integration: Configure RHEL and VMware networking within secure DoD frameworks, managing VLANs, vSwitches, and firewalls. Access Control: Manage Identity and Access Management (IdAM) utilizing Active Directory, LDAP, and PKI/CAC authentication. Automation: Develop Bash, Python, or Ansible scripts to automate configuration management, patching, and STIG compliance checks. Documentation: Author and maintain Risk Management Framework (RMF) artifacts, system architectures, and standard operating procedures (SOPs). Qualifications Required Qualifications: Experience: 5+ years of system administration experience supporting DoD enterprise networks. Hardware Expertise: Hands-on experience lifecycle-managing Dell PowerEdge servers and utilizing Dell OpenManage or iDRAC tools. Linux Expertise: Advanced knowledge of RHEL deployment, troubleshooting, storage management (LVM), and performance tuning. Virtualization Expertise: Proven experience managing VMware ESXi clusters, vCenter, vMotion, and high-availability configurations. DoD Compliance: Direct experience with RMF, DISA STIG implementation, and SCAP Compliance Checker (SCC). Security Certification: Active CompTIA Security+ CE, CCNA Security, CySA+, or CISSP. OS/Hardware Certification: Red Hat Certified System Administrator (RHCSA/RHCE), VMware Certified Professional (VCP), or Dell Technologies certifications. Preferred Skills: Experience deploying and scaling Dell VxRail or VMware vSAN Hyper-Converged solutions. Experience with automation platforms like Red Hat Ansible Tower or Horizon.
